# Solar System Colonization's per-world effects, from gen_solar_sites.SITES.

# Solar System Colonization - establish a colony at a random unclaimed location.
# Only a site a fleet can leave for now is drawn, and only among the cheapest
# (Global Commons § 5.2): each site's trigger asks sr_launch_site_departs for
# its window body (Mercury, never gated, sr_launch_mercury_departs). The body of
# each site is the generator's BODIES table (scripts/generators/
# gen_launch_windows.py; test_launch_windows.py holds the two equal). Called
# from sr_launch_month only, which checks first that some site can depart.
# The claim names its holder (sr_site_holder_<key>), and the site's sync puts
# it on the holder's count; the specialization follows in the event. Each
# stage also lists every earlier stage's worlds: they are claimed while those
# stages are full, so their branches pass only for a released world (a dead
# holder with no heir, design § 6).
sr_establish_colony_effect = {
	# Initialize stage if needed
	if = {

	# claimed (stage 5 full) the stage lists below have no valid entry and
	# claim nothing, so the first-colony charter must follow an actual claim,
	# not the bar filling.
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_colonies_claimed_before value = sr_total_global_colonies }

			}

	}

	# A site was claimed: the site's sync has counted it for this country.
	# The national/international charter story follows a real first colony.
	# Delay it past the location's own specialization event (duration = 3).
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_colonies_claimed_before < sr_total_global_colonies }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:sr_colony_count = 1
				NOT = { has_variable = ste_event_18_fired }
			}
			set_variable = { name = sr_colony_charter_pending value = yes days = 14 }
			trigger_event = { id = society_technology_events.18 days = 7 }
		}
	}

	# Check stage advancement after establishing colony
	sr_check_colony_stage_effect = yes
}

# Check if current colonization stage is complete and advance
sr_check_colony_stage_effect = {
	# Stage 1 complete → Stage 2
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:sr_colonization_stage = 1
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_olympus_mons
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_hellas_planitia
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_utopia_planitia
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_arcadia_planitia
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_ceres
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_vesta
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_psyche
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_pallas
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_hygiea
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colonization_stage value = 2 }
	}
	# Stage 2 complete → Stage 3
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:sr_colonization_stage = 2
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_io
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_europa
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_ganymede
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_callisto
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_himalia
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_amalthea
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_venus
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colonization_stage value = 3 }
	}
	# Stage 3 complete → Stage 4
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:sr_colonization_stage = 3
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_mercury
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_titan
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_enceladus
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_rhea
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_mimas
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_iapetus
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colonization_stage value = 4 }
	}
	# Stage 4 complete → Stage 5
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:sr_colonization_stage = 4
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_titania
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_oberon
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_miranda
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_ariel
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_triton
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_proteus
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colonization_stage value = 5 }
	}
	# Stage 5 complete → All done
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:sr_colonization_stage = 5
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_pluto
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_eris
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_makemake
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_haumea
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_sedna
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_all_colonies_complete value = yes }
	}
}

# ===== Per world: the projection, release, transfer and monthly step =====

# --- Valles Marineris (valles_marineris), stage 1 ---
sr_site_sync_valles_marineris = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_valles_marineris
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_valles_marineris ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_valles_marineris ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_valles_marineris = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_valles_marineris
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris = { sr_site_mirror_on_valles_marineris = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_valles_marineris value = global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_valles_marineris = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris global_var:sr_site_spec_valles_marineris = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_valles_marineris_research }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_valles_marineris_mining }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris global_var:sr_site_spec_valles_marineris = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_valles_marineris_mining }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_valles_marineris_research }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_valles_marineris = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_valles_marineris_research }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_valles_marineris_mining }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_valles_marineris }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_valles_marineris = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris }
	sr_site_sync_valles_marineris = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_valles_marineris }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released valles_marineris"
}
# Moves Valles Marineris to scope:sr_site_to_valles_marineris; scope:sr_site_from_valles_marineris, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_valles_marineris = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_valles_marineris ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris value = scope:sr_site_to_valles_marineris }
		sr_site_sync_valles_marineris = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_valles_marineris = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 1 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_valles_marineris ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 1 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_valles_marineris = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_valles_marineris value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder valles_marineris: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder valles_marineris: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_valles_marineris ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_valles_marineris }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_valles_marineris }
			sr_site_transfer_valles_marineris = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder valles_marineris: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		else = {
			sr_site_release_valles_marineris = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris_research_held has_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris_mining_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_valles_marineris
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_valles_marineris }
			sr_site_transfer_valles_marineris = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_valles_marineris = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_valles_marineris = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_valles_marineris
			global_var:sr_site_pop_valles_marineris > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_valles_marineris
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_valles_marineris
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_valles_marineris
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Olympus Mons (olympus_mons), stage 1 ---
sr_site_sync_olympus_mons = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_olympus_mons
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_olympus_mons ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_olympus_mons ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_olympus_mons = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_olympus_mons
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons = { sr_site_mirror_on_olympus_mons = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_olympus_mons value = global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_olympus_mons = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_olympus_mons global_var:sr_site_spec_olympus_mons = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_olympus_mons_atmospheric }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_olympus_mons_geothermal }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_olympus_mons global_var:sr_site_spec_olympus_mons = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_olympus_mons_geothermal }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_olympus_mons_atmospheric }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_olympus_tubes global_var:sr_site_disc_olympus_tubes = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_olympus_tubes_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_olympus_tubes_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = olympus_tubes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_olympus_tubes global_var:sr_site_disc_olympus_tubes = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_olympus_tubes_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_olympus_tubes_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = olympus_tubes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_olympus_tubes_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = olympus_tubes }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_olympus_mons = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_olympus_mons_atmospheric }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_olympus_mons_geothermal }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_olympus_tubes_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_olympus_tubes_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = olympus_tubes }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_olympus_mons } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_olympus_mons }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_olympus_mons = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons }
	sr_site_sync_olympus_mons = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_olympus_tubes } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_olympus_tubes }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_olympus_tubes_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_olympus_tubes_pending }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released olympus_mons"
}
# Moves Olympus Mons to scope:sr_site_to_olympus_mons; scope:sr_site_from_olympus_mons, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_olympus_mons = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_olympus_mons ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons value = scope:sr_site_to_olympus_mons }
		sr_site_sync_olympus_mons = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_olympus_mons = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 2 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_olympus_mons ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 2 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_olympus_mons = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_olympus_mons value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder olympus_mons: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder olympus_mons: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_olympus_mons ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_olympus_mons }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_olympus_mons }
			sr_site_transfer_olympus_mons = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder olympus_mons: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		else = {
			sr_site_release_olympus_mons = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_olympus_mons
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_olympus_mons_atmospheric_held has_variable = sr_colony_olympus_mons_geothermal_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_olympus_mons
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_olympus_mons }
			sr_site_transfer_olympus_mons = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_olympus_mons = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_olympus_mons = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_olympus_mons
			global_var:sr_site_pop_olympus_mons > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_olympus_mons
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_olympus_mons
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_olympus_mons
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Hellas Planitia (hellas_planitia), stage 1 ---
sr_site_sync_hellas_planitia = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_hellas_planitia
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_hellas_planitia ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_hellas_planitia ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_hellas_planitia = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_hellas_planitia
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia = { sr_site_mirror_on_hellas_planitia = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_hellas_planitia value = global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_hellas_planitia = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_hellas_planitia global_var:sr_site_spec_hellas_planitia = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_hellas_settlement }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_hellas_astrobiology }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_hellas_planitia global_var:sr_site_spec_hellas_planitia = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_hellas_astrobiology }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_hellas_settlement }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_hellas_fossils global_var:sr_site_disc_hellas_fossils = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_hellas_fossils_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_hellas_fossils_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = hellas_fossils }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_hellas_fossils global_var:sr_site_disc_hellas_fossils = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_hellas_fossils_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_hellas_fossils_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = hellas_fossils }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_hellas_fossils_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = hellas_fossils }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_hellas_planitia = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_hellas_settlement }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_hellas_astrobiology }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_hellas_fossils_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_hellas_fossils_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = hellas_fossils }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_hellas_planitia } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_hellas_planitia }

	sr_site_sync_hellas_planitia = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_hellas_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_hellas_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_hellas_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_hellas_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_hellas_fossils } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_hellas_fossils }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_hellas_fossils_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_hellas_fossils_pending }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released hellas_planitia"
}

		}

			if = {

				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder hellas_planitia: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}

			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_hellas_planitia ?= {

				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_hellas_planitia }
			}
		}
		if = {

			sr_site_transfer_hellas_planitia = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder hellas_planitia: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		else = {
			sr_site_release_hellas_planitia = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_hellas_planitia
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_hellas_settlement_held has_variable = sr_colony_hellas_astrobiology_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_hellas_planitia
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_hellas_planitia }
			sr_site_transfer_hellas_planitia = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_hellas_planitia = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_hellas_planitia = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_hellas_planitia
			global_var:sr_site_pop_hellas_planitia > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_hellas_planitia
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_hellas_planitia
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_hellas_planitia
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Utopia Planitia (utopia_planitia), stage 1 ---
sr_site_sync_utopia_planitia = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_utopia_planitia
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_utopia_planitia ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_utopia_planitia ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_utopia_planitia = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_utopia_planitia
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia = { sr_site_mirror_on_utopia_planitia = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_utopia_planitia value = global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_utopia_planitia = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_utopia_planitia global_var:sr_site_spec_utopia_planitia = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_utopia_ice }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_utopia_agriculture }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_utopia_planitia global_var:sr_site_spec_utopia_planitia = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_utopia_agriculture }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_utopia_ice }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_utopia_glacier global_var:sr_site_disc_utopia_glacier = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_utopia_glacier_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_utopia_glacier_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = utopia_glacier }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_utopia_glacier global_var:sr_site_disc_utopia_glacier = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_utopia_glacier_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_utopia_glacier_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = utopia_glacier }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_utopia_glacier_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = utopia_glacier }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_utopia_planitia = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_utopia_ice }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_utopia_agriculture }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_utopia_glacier_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_utopia_glacier_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = utopia_glacier }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_utopia_planitia } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_utopia_planitia }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_utopia_planitia = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia }
	sr_site_sync_utopia_planitia = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_utopia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_utopia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_utopia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_utopia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_utopia_glacier } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_utopia_glacier }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_utopia_glacier_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_utopia_glacier_pending }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released utopia_planitia"
}
# Moves Utopia Planitia to scope:sr_site_to_utopia_planitia; scope:sr_site_from_utopia_planitia, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_utopia_planitia = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_utopia_planitia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia value = scope:sr_site_to_utopia_planitia }
		sr_site_sync_utopia_planitia = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_utopia_planitia = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 4 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_utopia_planitia ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 4 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_utopia_planitia = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_utopia_planitia value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder utopia_planitia: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder utopia_planitia: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_utopia_planitia ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_utopia_planitia }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_utopia_planitia }
			sr_site_transfer_utopia_planitia = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder utopia_planitia: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		else = {
			sr_site_release_utopia_planitia = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_utopia_planitia
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_utopia_ice_held has_variable = sr_colony_utopia_agriculture_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_utopia_planitia
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_utopia_planitia }
			sr_site_transfer_utopia_planitia = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_utopia_planitia = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_utopia_planitia = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_utopia_planitia
			global_var:sr_site_pop_utopia_planitia > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_utopia_planitia
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_utopia_planitia
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_utopia_planitia
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Arcadia Planitia (arcadia_planitia), stage 1 ---
sr_site_sync_arcadia_planitia = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_arcadia_planitia
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_arcadia_planitia ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_arcadia_planitia ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_arcadia_planitia = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_arcadia_planitia
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia = { sr_site_mirror_on_arcadia_planitia = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_arcadia_planitia value = global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_arcadia_planitia = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_arcadia_planitia global_var:sr_site_spec_arcadia_planitia = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_arcadia_civilian }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_arcadia_military }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_arcadia_planitia global_var:sr_site_spec_arcadia_planitia = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_arcadia_military }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_arcadia_civilian }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_arcadia_brines global_var:sr_site_disc_arcadia_brines = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_arcadia_brines_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_arcadia_brines_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = arcadia_brines }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_arcadia_brines global_var:sr_site_disc_arcadia_brines = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_arcadia_brines_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_arcadia_brines_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = arcadia_brines }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_arcadia_brines_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = arcadia_brines }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_arcadia_planitia = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_arcadia_civilian }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_arcadia_military }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_arcadia_brines_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_arcadia_brines_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = arcadia_brines }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_arcadia_planitia } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_arcadia_planitia }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia }
	sr_site_sync_arcadia_planitia = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_arcadia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_arcadia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_arcadia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_arcadia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_arcadia_brines } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_arcadia_brines }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_arcadia_brines_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_arcadia_brines_pending }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released arcadia_planitia"
}
# Moves Arcadia Planitia to scope:sr_site_to_arcadia_planitia; scope:sr_site_from_arcadia_planitia, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_arcadia_planitia = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_arcadia_planitia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia value = scope:sr_site_to_arcadia_planitia }
		sr_site_sync_arcadia_planitia = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_arcadia_planitia = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 5 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_arcadia_planitia ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 5 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_arcadia_planitia = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_arcadia_planitia value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder arcadia_planitia: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder arcadia_planitia: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_arcadia_planitia ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_arcadia_planitia }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_arcadia_planitia }
			sr_site_transfer_arcadia_planitia = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder arcadia_planitia: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		else = {
			sr_site_release_arcadia_planitia = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_arcadia_planitia
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_arcadia_civilian_held has_variable = sr_colony_arcadia_military_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_arcadia_planitia
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_arcadia_planitia }
			sr_site_transfer_arcadia_planitia = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_arcadia_planitia = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_arcadia_planitia = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_arcadia_planitia
			global_var:sr_site_pop_arcadia_planitia > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_arcadia_planitia
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_arcadia_planitia
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_arcadia_planitia
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Ceres (ceres), stage 1 ---
sr_site_sync_ceres = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_ceres
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_ceres }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_ceres ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_ceres ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_ceres = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_ceres
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres = { sr_site_mirror_on_ceres = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_ceres value = global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_ceres = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_ceres global_var:sr_site_spec_ceres = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ceres_waystation }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ceres_observatory }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_ceres global_var:sr_site_spec_ceres = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ceres_observatory }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ceres_waystation }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_ceres_reservoir global_var:sr_site_disc_ceres_reservoir = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_ceres_reservoir_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_ceres_reservoir_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = ceres_reservoir }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_ceres_reservoir global_var:sr_site_disc_ceres_reservoir = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_ceres_reservoir_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_ceres_reservoir_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = ceres_reservoir }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_ceres_reservoir_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = ceres_reservoir }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_ceres = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ceres_waystation }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ceres_observatory }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_ceres_reservoir_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_ceres_reservoir_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = ceres_reservoir }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_ceres } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_ceres }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_ceres = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_ceres } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_ceres }
	sr_site_sync_ceres = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_ceres } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_ceres } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_ceres } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_ceres } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_ceres_reservoir } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_ceres_reservoir }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_ceres_reservoir_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_ceres_reservoir_pending }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released ceres"
}
# Moves Ceres to scope:sr_site_to_ceres; scope:sr_site_from_ceres, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_ceres = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_ceres ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_ceres value = scope:sr_site_to_ceres }
		sr_site_sync_ceres = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_ceres = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 6 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_ceres ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 6 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_ceres = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_ceres value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_ceres
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder ceres: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder ceres: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_ceres ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_ceres }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_ceres }
			sr_site_transfer_ceres = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder ceres: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		else = {
			sr_site_release_ceres = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_ceres
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_ceres }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_ceres_waystation_held has_variable = sr_colony_ceres_observatory_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_ceres
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_ceres }
			sr_site_transfer_ceres = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_ceres = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_ceres = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_ceres
			global_var:sr_site_pop_ceres > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_ceres
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_ceres
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_ceres
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- 4 Vesta (vesta), stage 1 ---
sr_site_sync_vesta = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_vesta
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_vesta }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_vesta ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_vesta }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_vesta ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_vesta = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_vesta
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_vesta ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_vesta = { sr_site_mirror_on_vesta = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_vesta value = global_var:sr_site_holder_vesta }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_vesta = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_vesta global_var:sr_site_spec_vesta = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_vesta_mining }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_vesta_science }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_vesta global_var:sr_site_spec_vesta = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_vesta_science }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_vesta_mining }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_vesta_impactor global_var:sr_site_disc_vesta_impactor = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_vesta_impactor_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_vesta_impactor_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = vesta_impactor }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_vesta_impactor global_var:sr_site_disc_vesta_impactor = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_vesta_impactor_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_vesta_impactor_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = vesta_impactor }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_vesta_impactor_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = vesta_impactor }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_vesta = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_vesta_mining }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_vesta_science }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_vesta_impactor_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_vesta_impactor_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = vesta_impactor }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_vesta } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_vesta }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_vesta = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_vesta } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_vesta }
	sr_site_sync_vesta = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_vesta } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_vesta }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_vesta } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_vesta }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_vesta } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_vesta }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_vesta } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_vesta }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_vesta_impactor } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_vesta_impactor }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_vesta_impactor_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_vesta_impactor_pending }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released vesta"
}

			}
		}

			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_pallas = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_pallas
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pallas ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_pallas = { sr_site_mirror_on_pallas = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_pallas value = global_var:sr_site_holder_pallas }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_pallas = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_pallas global_var:sr_site_spec_pallas = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pallas_composites }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pallas_observatory }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_pallas global_var:sr_site_spec_pallas = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pallas_observatory }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pallas_composites }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pallas_water global_var:sr_site_disc_pallas_water = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pallas_water_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pallas_water_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = pallas_water }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pallas_water global_var:sr_site_disc_pallas_water = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pallas_water_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pallas_water_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = pallas_water }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pallas_water_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = pallas_water }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_pallas = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pallas_composites }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pallas_observatory }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pallas_water_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pallas_water_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = pallas_water }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_pallas } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_pallas }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_pallas = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_pallas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_pallas }
	sr_site_sync_pallas = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_pallas } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_pallas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_pallas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_pallas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_pallas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_pallas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_pallas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_pallas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pallas_water } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pallas_water }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pallas_water_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pallas_water_pending }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released pallas"
}
# Moves 2 Pallas to scope:sr_site_to_pallas; scope:sr_site_from_pallas, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_pallas = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_pallas ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_pallas value = scope:sr_site_to_pallas }
		sr_site_sync_pallas = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_pallas = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 9 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_pallas ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 9 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_pallas = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_pallas ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_pallas value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_pallas
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pallas ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_pallas }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder pallas: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder pallas: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_pallas ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_pallas }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_pallas }
			sr_site_transfer_pallas = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pallas ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder pallas: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		else = {
			sr_site_release_pallas = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_pallas
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_pallas }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_pallas_composites_held has_variable = sr_colony_pallas_observatory_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_pallas
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_pallas }
			sr_site_transfer_pallas = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_pallas = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_pallas = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_pallas
			global_var:sr_site_pop_pallas > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_pallas
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_pallas
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_pallas
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- 10 Hygiea (hygiea), stage 1 ---
sr_site_sync_hygiea = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_hygiea
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_hygiea }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_hygiea ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_hygiea ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_hygiea = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_hygiea
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea = { sr_site_mirror_on_hygiea = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_hygiea value = global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_hygiea = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_hygiea global_var:sr_site_spec_hygiea = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_hygiea_volatiles }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_hygiea_automated }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_hygiea global_var:sr_site_spec_hygiea = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_hygiea_automated }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_hygiea_volatiles }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_hygiea = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_hygiea_volatiles }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_hygiea_automated }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_hygiea } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_hygiea }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_hygiea = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_hygiea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_hygiea }
	sr_site_sync_hygiea = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_hygiea } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_hygiea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_hygiea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_hygiea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_hygiea }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released hygiea"
}

# --- Io (io), stage 2 ---
sr_site_sync_io = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_io
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_io }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_io ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_io }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_io ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_io = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_io
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_io = { sr_site_mirror_on_io = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_io value = global_var:sr_site_holder_io }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_io = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_io global_var:sr_site_spec_io = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_io_mining }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_io_research }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_io global_var:sr_site_spec_io = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_io_research }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_io_mining }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_io_roof global_var:sr_site_disc_io_roof = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_io_roof_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_io_roof_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = io_roof }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_io_roof global_var:sr_site_disc_io_roof = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_io_roof_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_io_roof_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = io_roof }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_io_roof_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = io_roof }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_io = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_io_mining }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_io_research }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_io_roof_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_io_roof_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = io_roof }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_io } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_io }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_io }
	sr_site_sync_io = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_io } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_io_roof } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_io_roof }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_io_roof_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_io_roof_pending }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released io"
}

			}

}

			}

		}

		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_io = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_io
			global_var:sr_site_pop_io > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_io
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_io
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_io
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Europa (europa), stage 2 ---
sr_site_sync_europa = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_europa
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_europa }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_europa ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_europa }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_europa ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_europa = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_europa
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_europa ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_europa = { sr_site_mirror_on_europa = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_europa value = global_var:sr_site_holder_europa }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_europa = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_europa global_var:sr_site_spec_europa = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_europa_drilling }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_europa_surface }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_europa global_var:sr_site_spec_europa = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_europa_surface }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_europa_drilling }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_europa_life global_var:sr_site_disc_europa_life = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_europa_life_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_europa_life_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = europa_life }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_europa_life global_var:sr_site_disc_europa_life = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_europa_life_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_europa_life_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = europa_life }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_europa_life_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = europa_life }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_europa_vents global_var:sr_site_disc_europa_vents = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_europa_vents_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_europa_vents_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = europa_vents }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_europa_vents global_var:sr_site_disc_europa_vents = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_europa_vents_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_europa_vents_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = europa_vents }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_europa_vents_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = europa_vents }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_europa = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_europa_drilling }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_europa_surface }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_europa_life_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_europa_life_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = europa_life }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_europa_vents_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_europa_vents_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = europa_vents }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_europa } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_europa }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_europa = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_europa } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_europa }
	sr_site_sync_europa = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_europa } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_europa }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_europa } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_europa }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_europa } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_europa }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_europa } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_europa }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_europa_life } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_europa_life }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_europa_life_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_europa_life_pending }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_europa_vents } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_europa_vents }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_europa_vents_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_europa_vents_pending }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released europa"
}
# Moves Europa to scope:sr_site_to_europa; scope:sr_site_from_europa, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_europa = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_europa ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_europa value = scope:sr_site_to_europa }
		sr_site_sync_europa = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_europa = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 12 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_europa ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 12 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_europa = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_europa ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_europa value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_europa
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_europa ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_europa }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder europa: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder europa: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_europa ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_europa }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_europa }
			sr_site_transfer_europa = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_europa ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder europa: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		else = {
			sr_site_release_europa = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_europa
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_europa }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_europa_drilling_held has_variable = sr_colony_europa_surface_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_europa
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_europa }
			sr_site_transfer_europa = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_europa = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_europa = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_europa
			global_var:sr_site_pop_europa > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_europa
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_europa
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_europa
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Ganymede (ganymede), stage 2 ---

}
sr_site_unmirror_callisto = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_callisto_gateway }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_callisto_agricultural }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_callisto_archive_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_callisto_archive_b }

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_callisto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_callisto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_callisto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_callisto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_callisto_archive } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_callisto_archive }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_callisto_archive_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_callisto_archive_pending }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released callisto"
}
# Moves Callisto to scope:sr_site_to_callisto; scope:sr_site_from_callisto, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_callisto = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_callisto ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_callisto value = scope:sr_site_to_callisto }
		sr_site_sync_callisto = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_callisto = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 14 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_callisto ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 14 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_callisto = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_callisto ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_callisto value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_callisto
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_callisto ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_callisto }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder callisto: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder callisto: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_callisto ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_callisto }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_callisto }
			sr_site_transfer_callisto = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_callisto ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder callisto: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		else = {
			sr_site_release_callisto = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_callisto
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_callisto }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_callisto_gateway_held has_variable = sr_colony_callisto_agricultural_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_callisto
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_callisto }
			sr_site_transfer_callisto = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_callisto = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_callisto = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_callisto
			global_var:sr_site_pop_callisto > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_callisto
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_callisto
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_callisto
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Himalia (himalia), stage 2 ---
sr_site_sync_himalia = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_himalia
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_himalia }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_himalia ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_himalia ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_himalia = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_himalia
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia = { sr_site_mirror_on_himalia = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_himalia value = global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_himalia = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_himalia global_var:sr_site_spec_himalia = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_himalia_telescope }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_himalia_depot }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_himalia global_var:sr_site_spec_himalia = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_himalia_depot }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_himalia_telescope }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_himalia = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_himalia_telescope }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_himalia_depot }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_himalia } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_himalia }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_himalia = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_himalia }
	sr_site_sync_himalia = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_himalia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_himalia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_himalia }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released himalia"
}
# Moves Himalia to scope:sr_site_to_himalia; scope:sr_site_from_himalia, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).

	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_himalia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }

		scope:sr_site_from_himalia ?= {

				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 15 }
			}
		}

	}
}

		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_himalia
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }

				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_himalia }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_himalia }
			sr_site_transfer_himalia = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder himalia: the heir did not take it"

		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_himalia_telescope_held has_variable = sr_colony_himalia_depot_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_himalia
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_himalia }
			sr_site_transfer_himalia = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_himalia = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_himalia = yes

				max = sr_site_room_himalia
			}
		}
	}
}

				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder amalthea: the heir did not take it"
