	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_amalthea
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_amalthea }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_amalthea_physics_held has_variable = sr_colony_amalthea_rings_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_amalthea
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_amalthea }
			sr_site_transfer_amalthea = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }

		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.

				max = sr_site_room_amalthea
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Venus Cloud Habitat (venus), stage 2 ---
sr_site_sync_venus = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_venus
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_venus }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_venus ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_venus }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_venus ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_venus = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_venus
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_venus = { sr_site_mirror_on_venus = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_venus value = global_var:sr_site_holder_venus }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_venus = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_venus global_var:sr_site_spec_venus = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_venus_atmospheric }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_venus_extraction }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_venus global_var:sr_site_spec_venus = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_venus_extraction }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_venus_atmospheric }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_venus_waves global_var:sr_site_disc_venus_waves = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_venus_waves_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_venus_waves_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = venus_waves }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_venus_waves global_var:sr_site_disc_venus_waves = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_venus_waves_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_venus_waves_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = venus_waves }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_venus_waves_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = venus_waves }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_venus = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_venus_atmospheric }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_venus_extraction }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_venus_waves_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_venus_waves_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = venus_waves }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_venus } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_venus }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_venus = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_venus }
	sr_site_sync_venus = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_venus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_venus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_venus_waves } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_venus_waves }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_venus_waves_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_venus_waves_pending }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released venus"
}
# Moves Venus Cloud Habitat to scope:sr_site_to_venus; scope:sr_site_from_venus, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_venus = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_venus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_venus value = scope:sr_site_to_venus }
		sr_site_sync_venus = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_venus = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 17 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_venus ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 17 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_venus = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_venus value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_venus
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_venus }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder venus: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder venus: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_venus ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_venus }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_venus }
			sr_site_transfer_venus = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder venus: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		else = {
			sr_site_release_venus = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_venus
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_venus }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_venus_atmospheric_held has_variable = sr_colony_venus_extraction_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_venus
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_venus }
			sr_site_transfer_venus = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_venus = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_venus = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_venus
			global_var:sr_site_pop_venus > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_venus
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_venus
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_venus
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Mercury (mercury), stage 3 ---
sr_site_sync_mercury = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_mercury
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_mercury }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_mercury ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_mercury ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_mercury = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_mercury
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury = { sr_site_mirror_on_mercury = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_mercury value = global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_mercury = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_mercury global_var:sr_site_spec_mercury = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mercury_solar }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mercury_ice }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_mercury global_var:sr_site_spec_mercury = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mercury_ice }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mercury_solar }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_mercury_archive global_var:sr_site_disc_mercury_archive = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_mercury_archive_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_mercury_archive_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = mercury_archive }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_mercury_archive global_var:sr_site_disc_mercury_archive = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_mercury_archive_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_mercury_archive_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = mercury_archive }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_mercury_archive_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = mercury_archive }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_mercury = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mercury_solar }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_mercury_ice }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_mercury_archive_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_mercury_archive_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = mercury_archive }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_mercury } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_mercury }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_mercury = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_mercury } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_mercury }
	sr_site_sync_mercury = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_mercury } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_mercury } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_mercury } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_mercury } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_mercury }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_mercury_archive } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_mercury_archive }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_mercury_archive_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_mercury_archive_pending }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released mercury"
}

			}

}

	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_enceladus_life global_var:sr_site_disc_enceladus_life = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_enceladus_life_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_enceladus_life_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = enceladus_life }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_enceladus_life global_var:sr_site_disc_enceladus_life = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_enceladus_life_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_enceladus_life_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = enceladus_life }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_enceladus_life_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = enceladus_life }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_enceladus = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_enceladus_astrobiology }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_enceladus_water }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_enceladus_life_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_enceladus_life_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = enceladus_life }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_enceladus } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_enceladus }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_enceladus = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_enceladus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_enceladus }
	sr_site_sync_enceladus = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_enceladus } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_enceladus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_enceladus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_enceladus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_enceladus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_enceladus_life } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_enceladus_life }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_enceladus_life_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_enceladus_life_pending }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released enceladus"
}
# Moves Enceladus to scope:sr_site_to_enceladus; scope:sr_site_from_enceladus, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_enceladus = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_enceladus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_enceladus value = scope:sr_site_to_enceladus }
		sr_site_sync_enceladus = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_enceladus = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 20 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_enceladus ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 20 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_enceladus = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_enceladus ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_enceladus value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_enceladus
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_enceladus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_enceladus }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder enceladus: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder enceladus: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_enceladus ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_enceladus }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_enceladus }
			sr_site_transfer_enceladus = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_enceladus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder enceladus: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		else = {
			sr_site_release_enceladus = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_enceladus
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_enceladus }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_enceladus_astrobiology_held has_variable = sr_colony_enceladus_water_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_enceladus
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_enceladus }
			sr_site_transfer_enceladus = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_enceladus = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_enceladus = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_enceladus
			global_var:sr_site_pop_enceladus > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_enceladus
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_enceladus
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_enceladus
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Rhea (rhea), stage 3 ---
sr_site_sync_rhea = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_rhea
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_rhea }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_rhea ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_rhea }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_rhea ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_rhea = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_rhea
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_rhea ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_rhea = { sr_site_mirror_on_rhea = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_rhea value = global_var:sr_site_holder_rhea }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_rhea = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_rhea global_var:sr_site_spec_rhea = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_rhea_propellant }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_rhea_observation }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_rhea global_var:sr_site_spec_rhea = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_rhea_observation }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_rhea_propellant }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_rhea = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_rhea_propellant }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_rhea_observation }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_rhea } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_rhea }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_rhea = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_rhea }
	sr_site_sync_rhea = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_rhea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_rhea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_rhea }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released rhea"
}
# Moves Rhea to scope:sr_site_to_rhea; scope:sr_site_from_rhea, when saved,

		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {

			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_rhea

			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_rhea
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_rhea }
			sr_site_transfer_rhea = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_rhea = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_rhea = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_rhea
			global_var:sr_site_pop_rhea > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_rhea
			value = {

				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_rhea
			}

	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_iapetus_ridge }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_iapetus_organics }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_iapetus } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_iapetus }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_iapetus = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_iapetus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_iapetus }
	sr_site_sync_iapetus = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_iapetus } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_iapetus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_iapetus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_iapetus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_iapetus } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_iapetus }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released iapetus"
}
# Moves Iapetus to scope:sr_site_to_iapetus; scope:sr_site_from_iapetus, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_iapetus = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_iapetus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_iapetus value = scope:sr_site_to_iapetus }
		sr_site_sync_iapetus = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_iapetus = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 23 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_iapetus ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 23 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_iapetus = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_iapetus value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_iapetus
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder iapetus: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder iapetus: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_iapetus ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_iapetus }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_iapetus }
			sr_site_transfer_iapetus = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder iapetus: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		else = {
			sr_site_release_iapetus = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_iapetus
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_iapetus }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_iapetus_ridge_held has_variable = sr_colony_iapetus_organics_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_iapetus
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_iapetus }
			sr_site_transfer_iapetus = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_iapetus = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_iapetus = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_iapetus
			global_var:sr_site_pop_iapetus > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_iapetus
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_iapetus
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_iapetus
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Titania (titania), stage 4 ---
sr_site_sync_titania = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_titania
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_titania }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_titania ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_titania }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_titania ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_titania = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_titania
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titania ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_titania = { sr_site_mirror_on_titania = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_titania value = global_var:sr_site_holder_titania }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_titania = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_titania global_var:sr_site_spec_titania = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titania_mining }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titania_geophysics }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_titania global_var:sr_site_spec_titania = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titania_geophysics }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titania_mining }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titania_ocean global_var:sr_site_disc_titania_ocean = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titania_ocean_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titania_ocean_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = titania_ocean }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titania_ocean global_var:sr_site_disc_titania_ocean = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titania_ocean_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titania_ocean_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = titania_ocean }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titania_ocean_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = titania_ocean }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_titania = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titania_mining }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_titania_geophysics }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titania_ocean_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_titania_ocean_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = titania_ocean }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_titania } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_titania }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_titania = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_titania }
	sr_site_sync_titania = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_titania } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_titania }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titania_ocean } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titania_ocean }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titania_ocean_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_titania_ocean_pending }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released titania"
}
# Moves Titania to scope:sr_site_to_titania; scope:sr_site_from_titania, when saved,

				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_oberon_relay_held has_variable = sr_colony_oberon_research_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_oberon
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_oberon }
			sr_site_transfer_oberon = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }

}
sr_site_release_miranda = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_miranda }
	sr_site_sync_miranda = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_miranda }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released miranda"
}
# Moves Miranda to scope:sr_site_to_miranda; scope:sr_site_from_miranda, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_miranda = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_miranda ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_miranda value = scope:sr_site_to_miranda }
		sr_site_sync_miranda = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_miranda = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 26 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_miranda ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 26 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_miranda = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_miranda value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_miranda
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder miranda: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder miranda: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_miranda ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_miranda }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_miranda }
			sr_site_transfer_miranda = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder miranda: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		else = {
			sr_site_release_miranda = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_miranda
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_miranda }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_miranda_rupes_held has_variable = sr_colony_miranda_drilling_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_miranda
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_miranda }
			sr_site_transfer_miranda = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_miranda = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_miranda = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_miranda
			global_var:sr_site_pop_miranda > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_miranda
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_miranda
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_miranda
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Ariel (ariel), stage 4 ---
sr_site_sync_ariel = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_ariel
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_ariel }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_ariel ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_ariel ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_ariel = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_ariel
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel = { sr_site_mirror_on_ariel = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_ariel value = global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_ariel = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_ariel global_var:sr_site_spec_ariel = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ariel_cryovolcanic }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ariel_quarrying }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_ariel global_var:sr_site_spec_ariel = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ariel_quarrying }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ariel_cryovolcanic }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_ariel = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ariel_cryovolcanic }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_ariel_quarrying }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_ariel } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_ariel }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_ariel = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_ariel } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_ariel }
	sr_site_sync_ariel = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_ariel } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_ariel }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_ariel } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_ariel }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_ariel } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_ariel }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_ariel } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_ariel }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released ariel"
}

			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_ariel
			global_var:sr_site_pop_ariel > 0

# --- Triton (triton), stage 4 ---
sr_site_sync_triton = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_triton
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_triton }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_triton ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_triton }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_triton ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_triton = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_triton
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_triton ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_triton = { sr_site_mirror_on_triton = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_triton value = global_var:sr_site_holder_triton }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_triton = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_triton global_var:sr_site_spec_triton = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_triton_geyser }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_triton_gateway }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_triton global_var:sr_site_spec_triton = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_triton_gateway }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_triton_geyser }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_triton_jet global_var:sr_site_disc_triton_jet = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_triton_jet_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_triton_jet_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = triton_jet }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_triton_jet global_var:sr_site_disc_triton_jet = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_triton_jet_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_triton_jet_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = triton_jet }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_triton_jet_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = triton_jet }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_triton = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_triton_geyser }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_triton_gateway }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_triton_jet_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_triton_jet_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = triton_jet }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_triton } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_triton }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_triton = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_triton }
	sr_site_sync_triton = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_triton } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_triton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_triton_jet } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_triton_jet }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_triton_jet_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_triton_jet_pending }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released triton"
}

}
# Moves Proteus to scope:sr_site_to_proteus; scope:sr_site_from_proteus, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_proteus = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_proteus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_proteus value = scope:sr_site_to_proteus }
		sr_site_sync_proteus = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_proteus = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 29 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_proteus ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 29 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_proteus = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_proteus ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_proteus value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_proteus
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_proteus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_proteus }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder proteus: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder proteus: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_proteus ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_proteus }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_proteus }
			sr_site_transfer_proteus = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_proteus ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder proteus: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		else = {
			sr_site_release_proteus = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_proteus
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_proteus }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_proteus_probe_held has_variable = sr_colony_proteus_extraction_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_proteus
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_proteus }
			sr_site_transfer_proteus = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_proteus = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_proteus = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_proteus
			global_var:sr_site_pop_proteus > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_proteus
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_proteus
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_proteus
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Pluto-Charon (pluto), stage 5 ---
sr_site_sync_pluto = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_pluto
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_pluto }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_pluto ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_pluto ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_pluto = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_pluto
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto = { sr_site_mirror_on_pluto = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_pluto value = global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_pluto = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_pluto global_var:sr_site_spec_pluto = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pluto_research }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pluto_harvesting }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_pluto global_var:sr_site_spec_pluto = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pluto_harvesting }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pluto_research }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze global_var:sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pluto_antifreeze_a }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pluto_antifreeze_b }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = pluto_antifreeze }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze global_var:sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pluto_antifreeze_b }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pluto_antifreeze_a }
		sr_site_set_discovery_done = { DISCOVERY = pluto_antifreeze }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze_pending }
		sr_site_set_discovery_pending = { DISCOVERY = pluto_antifreeze }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_pluto = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pluto_research }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_pluto_harvesting }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pluto_antifreeze_a }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_discovery_pluto_antifreeze_b }
	sr_site_clear_discovery = { DISCOVERY = pluto_antifreeze }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_pluto } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_pluto }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_pluto = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_pluto }
	sr_site_sync_pluto = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_pluto } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_pluto }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_pluto_antifreeze_pending }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released pluto"
}
# Moves Pluto-Charon to scope:sr_site_to_pluto; scope:sr_site_from_pluto, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).

				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 30 }
			}
		}

	}
}

			}

	}
}

# --- Makemake (makemake), stage 5 ---

		limit = {

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_makemake }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_makemake } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_makemake }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released makemake"
}

# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).

	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_makemake ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_makemake value = scope:sr_site_to_makemake }
		sr_site_sync_makemake = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_makemake = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 32 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_makemake ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 32 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_makemake = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_makemake value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_makemake
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder makemake: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder makemake: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_makemake ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_makemake }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_makemake }
			sr_site_transfer_makemake = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder makemake: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		else = {
			sr_site_release_makemake = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_makemake
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_makemake }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_makemake_chemistry_held has_variable = sr_colony_makemake_solarwind_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_makemake
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_makemake }
			sr_site_transfer_makemake = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_makemake = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_makemake = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_makemake
			global_var:sr_site_pop_makemake > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_makemake
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_makemake
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_makemake
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Haumea (haumea), stage 5 ---
sr_site_sync_haumea = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_haumea
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_haumea }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_haumea ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_haumea ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_haumea = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_haumea
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea = { sr_site_mirror_on_haumea = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_haumea value = global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_haumea = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_haumea global_var:sr_site_spec_haumea = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_haumea_dynamics }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_haumea_rings }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_haumea global_var:sr_site_spec_haumea = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_haumea_rings }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_haumea_dynamics }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_haumea = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_haumea_dynamics }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_haumea_rings }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_haumea } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_haumea }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_haumea = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_haumea }
	sr_site_sync_haumea = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_haumea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_haumea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_haumea }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released haumea"
}
# Moves Haumea to scope:sr_site_to_haumea; scope:sr_site_from_haumea, when saved,
# is the country it leaves. CAUSE names what follows (sr_site_effects.txt):
# treaty (Cede Colony), heir (a dead holder's), quiet (an adoption).
sr_site_transfer_haumea = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:sr_site_to_haumea ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_haumea value = scope:sr_site_to_haumea }
		sr_site_sync_haumea = yes
		scope:sr_site_to_haumea = { sr_site_gained_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 33 } }
		scope:sr_site_from_haumea ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 33 }
			}
		}
		sr_sites_refresh_players = yes
	}
}
sr_site_monthly_haumea = {
	# 1. The holder's capital, for the dead-holder rule.
	global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea ?= {
		if = {
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_region_haumea value = capital.state_region }
		}
	}
	# 2. A dead holder: its capital region's owner inherits, or the world is released.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_haumea
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}
		# Self-check (once a game): which guard caught the dead holder.
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted value = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder haumea: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"
			}
			else = {
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder haumea: exists caught it"
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_region_haumea ?= {
			ordered_scope_state = {
				limit = { owner = { sr_site_can_hold = yes } }
				order_by = state_population
				max = 1
				owner = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_haumea }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_haumea }
			sr_site_transfer_haumea = { CAUSE = heir }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea ?= { is_country_alive = yes } } }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder haumea: the heir did not take it"
			}
		}
		else = {
			sr_site_release_haumea = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_haumea
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_haumea }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_haumea_dynamics_held has_variable = sr_colony_haumea_rings_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_haumea
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_haumea }
			sr_site_transfer_haumea = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_haumea = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_haumea = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_haumea
			global_var:sr_site_pop_haumea > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_haumea
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_haumea
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_haumea
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- Sedna (sedna), stage 5 ---
sr_site_sync_sedna = {
	# The country that shows the site and no longer holds it loses it.
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_sedna
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_sedna }
				NOT = { global_var:sr_site_mirror_sedna ?= global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna }
			}
		}
		global_var:sr_site_mirror_sedna ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { is_country_alive = yes }
				sr_site_unmirror_sedna = yes
			}
		}
		remove_global_variable = sr_site_mirror_sedna
	}
	# The holder shows it.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna = { sr_site_mirror_on_sedna = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_mirror_sedna value = global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna }
	}
}
sr_site_mirror_on_sedna = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_sedna global_var:sr_site_spec_sedna = 1 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_sedna_outpost }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_sedna_interstellar }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_sedna global_var:sr_site_spec_sedna = 2 }
		sr_site_show_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_sedna_interstellar }
		sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_sedna_outpost }
	}
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_unmirror_sedna = {
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_sedna_outpost }
	sr_site_hide_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_sedna_interstellar }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_emig_prio_sedna } remove_variable = sr_emig_prio_sedna }
	set_variable = { name = sr_colony_count value = sr_sites_held_count }
}
sr_site_release_sedna = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_sedna } remove_global_variable = sr_site_holder_sedna }
	sr_site_sync_sedna = yes
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_sedna } remove_global_variable = sr_colony_sedna }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_spec_sedna } remove_global_variable = sr_site_spec_sedna }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_region_sedna } remove_global_variable = sr_site_region_sedna }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_sedna } remove_global_variable = sr_site_pop_sedna }
	debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES released sedna"
}

		scope:sr_site_from_sedna ?= {

				sr_site_lost_$CAUSE$ = { INDEX = 34 }
			}
		}

	}
}

		}

			has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_sedna
			NOT = { global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		}

			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_dead_holder_noted } }

				limit = { exists = global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna }
				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK OK site_dead_holder sedna: the stored country exists, is_country_alive = no caught it"

			}
		}

			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_sedna }

				debug_log = "TE_SELF_CHECK BROKEN site_dead_holder sedna: the heir did not take it"
			}

			sr_site_release_sedna = yes
		}
	}
	# 3. A claim with no holder: a country showing it adopts it; after the grace, released.
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = sr_colony_sedna
			NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_sedna }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				OR = { has_variable = sr_colony_sedna_outpost_held has_variable = sr_colony_sedna_interstellar_held }
			}
			save_scope_as = sr_site_to_sedna
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:sr_site_to_sedna }
			sr_site_transfer_sedna = { CAUSE = quiet }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_sites_grace } }
			sr_site_release_sedna = yes
		}
	}
	# 4. The projection.
	sr_site_sync_sedna = yes
	# 5. Growth, up to the room (simple and full; slices 2-3 design § 10.2).
	if = {
		limit = {
			sr_colonies_contested_enabled = yes
			has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_sedna
			global_var:sr_site_pop_sedna > 0
		}
		set_global_variable = {
			name = sr_site_pop_sedna
			value = {
				value = global_var:sr_site_pop_sedna
				multiply = 1.002
				max = sr_site_room_sedna
			}
		}
	}
}

# ===== The choice dispatcher =====
# sr_grant_colony_modifier = { MODIFIER = m } calls sr_site_choose_<m>: a
# specialization records the world's choice, a discovery outcome the
# discovery's. ROOT is the country choosing. A world claimed under a save
# from before the record existed gets its holder here.
sr_site_choose_sr_colony_valles_marineris_research = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris value = root } }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris value = 1 }
	sr_site_sync_valles_marineris = yes
}
sr_site_choose_sr_colony_valles_marineris_mining = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris value = root } }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris value = 2 }
	sr_site_sync_valles_marineris = yes
}
sr_site_choose_sr_colony_olympus_mons_atmospheric = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons value = root } }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_spec_olympus_mons value = 1 }
	sr_site_sync_olympus_mons = yes
}
sr_site_choose_sr_colony_olympus_mons_geothermal = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons value = root } }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_spec_olympus_mons value = 2 }
	sr_site_sync_olympus_mons = yes
}

	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons value = root } }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_disc_olympus_tubes value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_olympus_tubes_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_olympus_tubes_pending }
	sr_site_sync_olympus_mons = yes
}

	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons value = root } }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_disc_olympus_tubes value = 2 }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_disc_olympus_tubes_pending } remove_global_variable = sr_site_disc_olympus_tubes_pending }
	sr_site_sync_olympus_mons = yes
}

# ===== A save from before the record (sr_sites_global_monthly, once) =====
# THIS is a country carrying colony records. Each _held writes its choice and,
# for a specialization, the holder; a pending discovery becomes global.
sr_sites_migrate_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris_research_held }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris value = this } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris_mining_held }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris value = this } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_spec_valles_marineris value = 2 }

		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_spec_olympus_mons value = 1 }

		limit = { has_variable = sr_colony_olympus_mons_geothermal_held }

		limit = { has_variable = sr_discovery_olympus_tubes_a_held }

		limit = { has_variable = sr_discovery_olympus_tubes_b_held }

		limit = { has_variable = sr_discovery_europa_vents_pending NOT = { has_variable = sr_discovery_europa_vents_done } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_disc_europa_vents_pending value = yes }
	}

# ===== A revolution's winner (sr_repair_after_civil_war) =====
# ROOT the winner. When the rebels won, every world the old government held
# is the winner's at once (the dead-holder rule would reach it a month later).
sr_sites_repoint_loser = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = te_cw_rebels_won
			var:te_cw_rebels_won = 1
			exists = scope:te_cw_loser
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= scope:te_cw_loser }
			set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris value = ROOT }
			sr_site_sync_valles_marineris = yes
		}
		if = {

# ===== The panel's Solar System rows (players; monthly and after a transfer) =====
# The holder's capital, which the row reads its name and flag through
# (gui_modding_guide.md gotcha #15: a country is read through a stored state).
sr_sites_refresh_snapshot = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris = { save_scope_as = sr_ss_holder }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ss_cap_valles_marineris value = scope:sr_ss_holder.capital }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ss_cap_valles_marineris } remove_variable = sr_ss_cap_valles_marineris }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons = { save_scope_as = sr_ss_holder }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ss_cap_olympus_mons value = scope:sr_ss_holder.capital }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia = { save_scope_as = sr_ss_holder }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ss_cap_hellas_planitia value = scope:sr_ss_holder.capital }

		global_var:sr_site_holder_proteus = { save_scope_as = sr_ss_holder }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ss_cap_proteus value = scope:sr_ss_holder.capital }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ss_cap_proteus } remove_variable = sr_ss_cap_proteus }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto = { save_scope_as = sr_ss_holder }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ss_cap_pluto value = scope:sr_ss_holder.capital }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ss_cap_pluto } remove_variable = sr_ss_cap_pluto }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_eris ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_eris = { save_scope_as = sr_ss_holder }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ss_cap_eris value = scope:sr_ss_holder.capital }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ss_cap_eris } remove_variable = sr_ss_cap_eris }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake = { save_scope_as = sr_ss_holder }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ss_cap_makemake value = scope:sr_ss_holder.capital }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ss_cap_makemake } remove_variable = sr_ss_cap_makemake }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea = { save_scope_as = sr_ss_holder }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ss_cap_haumea value = scope:sr_ss_holder.capital }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ss_cap_haumea } remove_variable = sr_ss_cap_haumea }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna = { save_scope_as = sr_ss_holder }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ss_cap_sedna value = scope:sr_ss_holder.capital }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ss_cap_sedna } remove_variable = sr_ss_cap_sedna }
}

# ===== Cede Colony (common/treaty_articles/124_cede_colony.txt) =====
# on_entry_into_force, with scope:sr_cede_source and scope:sr_cede_target
# saved. The world whose building type is the input, if the source still
# holds it, goes to the target.
sr_cede_colony_apply = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:article_options.input_building_type ?= bt:building_sr_site_valles_marineris
			global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= scope:sr_cede_source
		}
		scope:sr_cede_target = { save_scope_as = sr_site_to_valles_marineris }
		scope:sr_cede_source = { save_scope_as = sr_site_from_valles_marineris }
		sr_site_transfer_valles_marineris = { CAUSE = treaty }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_cede_matched value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			scope:article_options.input_building_type ?= bt:building_sr_site_olympus_mons

# ===== Console helpers (te_debug_space_race.2) =====
# Log every world's record.
sr_sites_debug_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris = { debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES valles_marineris: held by [THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]" }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris } debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES valles_marineris: held by a dead country" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris } debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES valles_marineris: claimed, no holder" }
	else = { debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES valles_marineris: unclaimed" }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons = { debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES olympus_mons: held by [THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]" }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons } debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES olympus_mons: held by a dead country" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_olympus_mons } debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES olympus_mons: claimed, no holder" }
	else = { debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES olympus_mons: unclaimed" }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia = { debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES hellas_planitia: held by [THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]" }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia } debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES hellas_planitia: held by a dead country" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_hellas_planitia } debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES hellas_planitia: claimed, no holder" }
	else = { debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES hellas_planitia: unclaimed" }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= { is_country_alive = yes } }
		global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia = { debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES utopia_planitia: held by [THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]" }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia } debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES utopia_planitia: held by a dead country" }
	else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_utopia_planitia } debug_log = "TE_SR_SITES utopia_planitia: claimed, no holder" }

# Claim the first unclaimed world for ROOT (no event: the console picks option a).
sr_sites_debug_claim_first_free = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colony_valles_marineris value = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris value = root }
		sr_grant_colony_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_valles_marineris_research }
		sr_sites_stage_after_claim = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_olympus_mons } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colony_olympus_mons value = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons value = root }
		sr_grant_colony_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_olympus_mons_atmospheric }
		sr_sites_stage_after_claim = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_hellas_planitia } }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colony_hellas_planitia value = yes }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia value = root }
		sr_grant_colony_modifier = { MODIFIER = sr_colony_hellas_settlement }
		sr_sites_stage_after_claim = yes
	}
	else_if = {

# Give ROOT's first colony to scope:sr_debug_receiver, as Cede Colony would.

	if = {

	}
	else_if = {

# Colony fleets and settlers (te_debug_space_race.3): every slot of ROOT's, and
# every world's inbound record and people.
sr_cf_debug_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_1_site has_variable = sr_cf_1_arrive }
		debug_log = "TE_SR_FLEETS slot 1: world [THIS.Var('sr_cf_1_site').GetValue|0] lands at month [THIS.Var('sr_cf_1_arrive').GetValue|0] (now [THIS.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0])"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_2_site has_variable = sr_cf_2_arrive }
		debug_log = "TE_SR_FLEETS slot 2: world [THIS.Var('sr_cf_2_site').GetValue|0] lands at month [THIS.Var('sr_cf_2_arrive').GetValue|0] (now [THIS.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0])"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_3_site has_variable = sr_cf_3_arrive }
		debug_log = "TE_SR_FLEETS slot 3: world [THIS.Var('sr_cf_3_site').GetValue|0] lands at month [THIS.Var('sr_cf_3_arrive').GetValue|0] (now [THIS.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0])"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_4_site has_variable = sr_cf_4_arrive }
		debug_log = "TE_SR_FLEETS slot 4: world [THIS.Var('sr_cf_4_site').GetValue|0] lands at month [THIS.Var('sr_cf_4_arrive').GetValue|0] (now [THIS.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0])"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_5_site has_variable = sr_cf_5_arrive }
		debug_log = "TE_SR_FLEETS slot 5: world [THIS.Var('sr_cf_5_site').GetValue|0] lands at month [THIS.Var('sr_cf_5_arrive').GetValue|0] (now [THIS.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0])"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cf_6_site has_variable = sr_cf_6_arrive }
		debug_log = "TE_SR_FLEETS slot 6: world [THIS.Var('sr_cf_6_site').GetValue|0] lands at month [THIS.Var('sr_cf_6_arrive').GetValue|0] (now [THIS.ScriptValue('te_history_month_index')|0])"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris }
		debug_log = "TE_SR_FLEETS valles_marineris: [GetGlobalVariable('sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris').GetValue|0] inbound, the first at month [GetGlobalVariable('sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris').GetValue|0]"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_valles_marineris }
		debug_log = "TE_SR_SETTLERS valles_marineris: [GetGlobalVariable('sr_site_pop_valles_marineris').GetValue|0] people of 50000"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_olympus_mons }
		debug_log = "TE_SR_FLEETS olympus_mons: [GetGlobalVariable('sr_site_inbound_olympus_mons').GetValue|0] inbound, the first at month [GetGlobalVariable('sr_site_inbound_first_olympus_mons').GetValue|0]"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_olympus_mons }
		debug_log = "TE_SR_SETTLERS olympus_mons: [GetGlobalVariable('sr_site_pop_olympus_mons').GetValue|0] people of 40000"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_hellas_planitia }
		debug_log = "TE_SR_FLEETS hellas_planitia: [GetGlobalVariable('sr_site_inbound_hellas_planitia').GetValue|0] inbound, the first at month [GetGlobalVariable('sr_site_inbound_first_hellas_planitia').GetValue|0]"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_hellas_planitia }
		debug_log = "TE_SR_SETTLERS hellas_planitia: [GetGlobalVariable('sr_site_pop_hellas_planitia').GetValue|0] people of 50000"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_utopia_planitia }
		debug_log = "TE_SR_FLEETS utopia_planitia: [GetGlobalVariable('sr_site_inbound_utopia_planitia').GetValue|0] inbound, the first at month [GetGlobalVariable('sr_site_inbound_first_utopia_planitia').GetValue|0]"
	}

# A fleet now for the first world ROOT may target, its cost added first so the
# bar is unchanged (simple and full).
sr_cf_debug_dispatch_first = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_cf_targetable_valles_marineris = yes sr_cf_departs_valles_marineris = yes }
		change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization add = sr_cf_cost_valles_marineris }
		sr_cf_dispatch_valles_marineris = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sr_cf_targetable_olympus_mons = yes sr_cf_departs_olympus_mons = yes }
		change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization add = sr_cf_cost_olympus_mons }
		sr_cf_dispatch_olympus_mons = yes
	}

		limit = { sr_cf_targetable_hellas_planitia = yes sr_cf_departs_hellas_planitia = yes }

		limit = { sr_cf_targetable_pluto = yes sr_cf_departs_pluto = yes }
		change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization add = sr_cf_cost_pluto }
		sr_cf_dispatch_pluto = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sr_cf_targetable_eris = yes sr_cf_departs_eris = yes }
		change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization add = sr_cf_cost_eris }
		sr_cf_dispatch_eris = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sr_cf_targetable_makemake = yes sr_cf_departs_makemake = yes }
		change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization add = sr_cf_cost_makemake }
		sr_cf_dispatch_makemake = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sr_cf_targetable_haumea = yes sr_cf_departs_haumea = yes }
		change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization add = sr_cf_cost_haumea }
		sr_cf_dispatch_haumea = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sr_cf_targetable_sedna = yes sr_cf_departs_sedna = yes }
		change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization add = sr_cf_cost_sedna }
		sr_cf_dispatch_sedna = yes
	}
}

# Release ROOT's first colony, as a dead holder with no heir would.
sr_sites_debug_release_first_held = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= root }
		sr_site_release_valles_marineris = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= root }
