# ===== Colony fleets (slices 2-3 design §§ 3-9) =====
# Per world: founding by THIS, a fleet's dispatch, a races-only target founded at
# once, a landing, and the inbound record. Dispatchers by index follow; the
# shared parts (slots, the launch month, notices) are hand-written in
# sr_colony_fleet_effects.txt.

# --- Valles Marineris ---
# THIS founds Valles Marineris: a colony fleet's arrival, or a target under races only.
sr_site_found_valles_marineris = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_colony_valles_marineris value = yes }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_valles_marineris value = this }
	sr_site_sync_valles_marineris = yes
	sr_cf_open_entry = yes
	trigger_event = { id = space_race_colony_events.1 }
}
# A fleet leaves for Valles Marineris: its cost spent, a slot filled, the world's inbound record.
sr_cf_dispatch_valles_marineris = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_cf_new_site value = 1 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_cf_new_arrive value = sr_cf_arrival_valles_marineris }
	set_variable = { name = sr_goal_before_colony value = sr_cf_cost_valles_marineris }
	change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization subtract = var:sr_goal_before_colony }
	sr_launch_window_gate_check = { BODY = mars }
	remove_variable = sr_goal_before_colony
	sr_cf_store_new = yes
}
sr_cf_found_now_valles_marineris = {
	set_variable = { name = sr_goal_before_colony value = sr_cf_cost_valles_marineris }
	change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization subtract = var:sr_goal_before_colony }
	sr_site_found_valles_marineris = yes
	sr_launch_window_gate_check = { BODY = mars }
	remove_variable = sr_goal_before_colony
}
# THIS's fleet bound for Valles Marineris lands: the world if free, else another of its body, else lost.
sr_cf_arrive_valles_marineris = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris } }
		sr_site_found_valles_marineris = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_olympus_mons } }
		sr_site_found_olympus_mons = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 2 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 1 FOUNDED = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_hellas_planitia } }
		sr_site_found_hellas_planitia = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 3 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 1 FOUNDED = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_utopia_planitia } }
		sr_site_found_utopia_planitia = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 4 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 1 FOUNDED = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_arcadia_planitia } }
		sr_site_found_arcadia_planitia = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 5 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 1 FOUNDED = 5 }
	}
	else = {
		sr_cf_note_lost = { TARGET = 1 }
	}
}
sr_cf_note_inbound_valles_marineris = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris value = 0 } }
	change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris }
				global_var:sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris > local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris value = local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_by_valles_marineris value = this }
	}
}

# --- Olympus Mons ---
# THIS founds Olympus Mons: a colony fleet's arrival, or a target under races only.
sr_site_found_olympus_mons = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_colony_olympus_mons value = yes }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_olympus_mons value = this }
	sr_site_sync_olympus_mons = yes
	sr_seed_colony_discovery = { DISCOVERY = olympus_tubes }
	sr_cf_open_entry = yes
	trigger_event = { id = space_race_colony_events.2 }
}

	set_local_variable = { name = sr_cf_new_site value = 2 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_cf_new_arrive value = sr_cf_arrival_olympus_mons }
	set_variable = { name = sr_goal_before_colony value = sr_cf_cost_olympus_mons }
	change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization subtract = var:sr_goal_before_colony }
	sr_launch_window_gate_check = { BODY = mars }
	remove_variable = sr_goal_before_colony
	sr_cf_store_new = yes

	set_variable = { name = sr_goal_before_colony value = sr_cf_cost_olympus_mons }

	sr_site_found_olympus_mons = yes
	sr_launch_window_gate_check = { BODY = mars }
	remove_variable = sr_goal_before_colony
}

		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_olympus_mons } }

		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris } }
		sr_site_found_valles_marineris = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 1 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 2 FOUNDED = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_hellas_planitia } }
		sr_site_found_hellas_planitia = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 3 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 2 FOUNDED = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_utopia_planitia } }
		sr_site_found_utopia_planitia = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 4 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 2 FOUNDED = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_arcadia_planitia } }
		sr_site_found_arcadia_planitia = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 5 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 2 FOUNDED = 5 }
	}
	else = {
		sr_cf_note_lost = { TARGET = 2 }
	}
}
sr_cf_note_inbound_olympus_mons = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_olympus_mons } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_olympus_mons value = 0 } }
	change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_olympus_mons add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_olympus_mons }
				global_var:sr_site_inbound_first_olympus_mons > local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_first_olympus_mons value = local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_by_olympus_mons value = this }
	}

		sr_site_found_valles_marineris = yes

		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 2 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 4 FOUNDED = 2 }

		sr_site_found_hellas_planitia = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 3 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 4 FOUNDED = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {

		sr_site_found_arcadia_planitia = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 5 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 4 FOUNDED = 5 }
	}

		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 11 FOUNDED = 12 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_ganymede } }
		sr_site_found_ganymede = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 13 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 11 FOUNDED = 13 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_callisto } }
		sr_site_found_callisto = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 14 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 11 FOUNDED = 14 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_himalia } }
		sr_site_found_himalia = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 15 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 11 FOUNDED = 15 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_amalthea } }
		sr_site_found_amalthea = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 16 }

sr_cf_note_inbound_io = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_io } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_io value = 0 } }
	change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_io add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_io }
				global_var:sr_site_inbound_first_io > local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_first_io value = local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_by_io value = this }
	}
}

# --- Europa ---
# THIS founds Europa: a colony fleet's arrival, or a target under races only.
sr_site_found_europa = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_colony_europa value = yes }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_europa value = this }
	sr_site_sync_europa = yes
	sr_seed_colony_discovery = { DISCOVERY = europa_life }
	sr_seed_colony_discovery = { DISCOVERY = europa_vents }
	sr_cf_open_entry = yes
	trigger_event = { id = space_race_colony_events.12 }
}
# A fleet leaves for Europa: its cost spent, a slot filled, the world's inbound record.
sr_cf_dispatch_europa = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_cf_new_site value = 12 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_cf_new_arrive value = sr_cf_arrival_europa }
	set_variable = { name = sr_goal_before_colony value = sr_cf_cost_europa }
	change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization subtract = var:sr_goal_before_colony }
	sr_launch_window_gate_check = { BODY = jupiter }
	remove_variable = sr_goal_before_colony
	sr_cf_store_new = yes
}
sr_cf_found_now_europa = {
	set_variable = { name = sr_goal_before_colony value = sr_cf_cost_europa }
	change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization subtract = var:sr_goal_before_colony }
	sr_site_found_europa = yes
	sr_launch_window_gate_check = { BODY = jupiter }
	remove_variable = sr_goal_before_colony
}
# THIS's fleet bound for Europa lands: the world if free, else another of its body, else lost.
sr_cf_arrive_europa = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_europa } }
		sr_site_found_europa = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 12 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_io } }
		sr_site_found_io = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 11 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 12 FOUNDED = 11 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_ganymede } }
		sr_site_found_ganymede = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 13 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 12 FOUNDED = 13 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_callisto } }
		sr_site_found_callisto = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 14 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 12 FOUNDED = 14 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_himalia } }
		sr_site_found_himalia = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 15 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 12 FOUNDED = 15 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_amalthea } }
		sr_site_found_amalthea = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 16 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 12 FOUNDED = 16 }
	}
	else = {
		sr_cf_note_lost = { TARGET = 12 }
	}
}
sr_cf_note_inbound_europa = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_europa } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_europa value = 0 } }
	change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_europa add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_europa }
				global_var:sr_site_inbound_first_europa > local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive

		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_venus }

		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 24 FOUNDED = 26 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_ariel } }
		sr_site_found_ariel = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 27 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 24 FOUNDED = 27 }
	}
	else = {
		sr_cf_note_lost = { TARGET = 24 }
	}
}
sr_cf_note_inbound_titania = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_titania } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_titania value = 0 } }
	change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_titania add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_titania }
				global_var:sr_site_inbound_first_titania > local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_first_titania value = local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_by_titania value = this }
	}
}

# --- Oberon ---
# THIS founds Oberon: a colony fleet's arrival, or a target under races only.
sr_site_found_oberon = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_colony_oberon value = yes }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_oberon value = this }
	sr_site_sync_oberon = yes
	sr_cf_open_entry = yes
	trigger_event = { id = space_race_colony_events.25 }
}
# A fleet leaves for Oberon: its cost spent, a slot filled, the world's inbound record.
sr_cf_dispatch_oberon = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_cf_new_site value = 25 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_cf_new_arrive value = sr_cf_arrival_oberon }
	set_variable = { name = sr_goal_before_colony value = sr_cf_cost_oberon }
	change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization subtract = var:sr_goal_before_colony }
	sr_launch_window_gate_check = { BODY = uranus }
	remove_variable = sr_goal_before_colony
	sr_cf_store_new = yes
}
sr_cf_found_now_oberon = {
	set_variable = { name = sr_goal_before_colony value = sr_cf_cost_oberon }
	change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization subtract = var:sr_goal_before_colony }
	sr_site_found_oberon = yes
	sr_launch_window_gate_check = { BODY = uranus }
	remove_variable = sr_goal_before_colony
}
# THIS's fleet bound for Oberon lands: the world if free, else another of its body, else lost.
sr_cf_arrive_oberon = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_oberon } }
		sr_site_found_oberon = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 25 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_titania } }
		sr_site_found_titania = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 24 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 25 FOUNDED = 24 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_miranda } }
		sr_site_found_miranda = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 26 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 25 FOUNDED = 26 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_ariel } }
		sr_site_found_ariel = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 27 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 25 FOUNDED = 27 }
	}
	else = {
		sr_cf_note_lost = { TARGET = 25 }
	}
}
sr_cf_note_inbound_oberon = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_oberon } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_oberon value = 0 } }
	change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_oberon add = 1 }

			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_oberon }

				global_var:sr_site_inbound_first_eris > local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_first_eris value = local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_by_eris value = this }
	}
}

# --- Makemake ---
# THIS founds Makemake: a colony fleet's arrival, or a target under races only.
sr_site_found_makemake = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_colony_makemake value = yes }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_holder_makemake value = this }
	sr_site_sync_makemake = yes
	sr_cf_open_entry = yes
	trigger_event = { id = space_race_colony_events.32 }
}
# A fleet leaves for Makemake: its cost spent, a slot filled, the world's inbound record.
sr_cf_dispatch_makemake = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_cf_new_site value = 32 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_cf_new_arrive value = sr_cf_arrival_makemake }
	set_variable = { name = sr_goal_before_colony value = sr_cf_cost_makemake }
	change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization subtract = var:sr_goal_before_colony }
	sr_launch_window_gate_check = { BODY = kuiper }
	remove_variable = sr_goal_before_colony
	sr_cf_store_new = yes
}
sr_cf_found_now_makemake = {
	set_variable = { name = sr_goal_before_colony value = sr_cf_cost_makemake }
	change_variable = { name = sr_progress_solar_colonization subtract = var:sr_goal_before_colony }
	sr_site_found_makemake = yes
	sr_launch_window_gate_check = { BODY = kuiper }
	remove_variable = sr_goal_before_colony
}
# THIS's fleet bound for Makemake lands: the world if free, else another of its body, else lost.
sr_cf_arrive_makemake = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_makemake } }
		sr_site_found_makemake = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 32 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_pluto } }
		sr_site_found_pluto = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 30 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 32 FOUNDED = 30 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_eris } }
		sr_site_found_eris = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 31 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 32 FOUNDED = 31 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_haumea } }
		sr_site_found_haumea = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 33 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 32 FOUNDED = 33 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_sedna } }
		sr_site_found_sedna = yes
		sr_cf_after_found = { INDEX = 34 }
		sr_cf_note_diverted = { TARGET = 32 FOUNDED = 34 }
	}
	else = {
		sr_cf_note_lost = { TARGET = 32 }
	}
}
sr_cf_note_inbound_makemake = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_makemake } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_makemake value = 0 } }
	change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_makemake add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_makemake }
				global_var:sr_site_inbound_first_makemake > local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_first_makemake value = local_var:sr_cf_new_arrive }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_inbound_by_makemake value = this }
	}
}

	else_if = {

	else_if = {

# Races only: the target founded at once (sr_cf_target_ready has passed), then the
# draw's own trailer: the first-colony charter, the stage check.
sr_cf_found_target_now = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_colonies_claimed_before value = sr_total_global_colonies }
	if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 1 }
		sr_cf_found_now_valles_marineris = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 2 }
		sr_cf_found_now_olympus_mons = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 3 }
		sr_cf_found_now_hellas_planitia = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 4 }
		sr_cf_found_now_utopia_planitia = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 5 }
		sr_cf_found_now_arcadia_planitia = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 6 }
		sr_cf_found_now_ceres = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 7 }
		sr_cf_found_now_vesta = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 8 }
		sr_cf_found_now_psyche = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 9 }
		sr_cf_found_now_pallas = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 10 }
		sr_cf_found_now_hygiea = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 11 }
		sr_cf_found_now_io = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 12 }
		sr_cf_found_now_europa = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 13 }
		sr_cf_found_now_ganymede = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 14 }
		sr_cf_found_now_callisto = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 15 }
		sr_cf_found_now_himalia = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 16 }
		sr_cf_found_now_amalthea = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 17 }
		sr_cf_found_now_venus = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 18 }
		sr_cf_found_now_mercury = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 19 }
		sr_cf_found_now_titan = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 20 }
		sr_cf_found_now_enceladus = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 21 }
		sr_cf_found_now_rhea = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 22 }
		sr_cf_found_now_mimas = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 23 }
		sr_cf_found_now_iapetus = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 24 }
		sr_cf_found_now_titania = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 25 }
		sr_cf_found_now_oberon = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 26 }
		sr_cf_found_now_miranda = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 27 }
		sr_cf_found_now_ariel = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 28 }
		sr_cf_found_now_triton = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 29 }
		sr_cf_found_now_proteus = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 30 }
		sr_cf_found_now_pluto = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 31 }
		sr_cf_found_now_eris = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 32 }
		sr_cf_found_now_makemake = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 33 }
		sr_cf_found_now_haumea = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_cf_target = 34 }
		sr_cf_found_now_sedna = yes
	}

	# A site was claimed: the site's sync has counted it for this country.
	# The national/international charter story follows a real first colony.
	# Delay it past the location's own specialization event (duration = 3).
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_colonies_claimed_before < sr_total_global_colonies }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:sr_colony_count = 1
				NOT = { has_variable = ste_event_18_fired }
			}
			set_variable = { name = sr_colony_charter_pending value = yes days = 14 }
			trigger_event = { id = society_technology_events.18 days = 7 }
		}
	}

	# Check stage advancement after establishing colony
	sr_check_colony_stage_effect = yes
}

# Simple and full, no target: the eligible world with the best score
# (local_var:sr_cf_best, set from sr_cf_best_score), the first in table order on a tie.
sr_cf_pick_auto = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_cf_eligible_valles_marineris = yes sr_cf_score_valles_marineris >= local_var:sr_cf_best }
		sr_cf_dispatch_valles_marineris = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sr_cf_eligible_olympus_mons = yes sr_cf_score_olympus_mons >= local_var:sr_cf_best }
		sr_cf_dispatch_olympus_mons = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sr_cf_eligible_hellas_planitia = yes sr_cf_score_hellas_planitia >= local_var:sr_cf_best }
		sr_cf_dispatch_hellas_planitia = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sr_cf_eligible_utopia_planitia = yes sr_cf_score_utopia_planitia >= local_var:sr_cf_best }
		sr_cf_dispatch_utopia_planitia = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sr_cf_eligible_arcadia_planitia = yes sr_cf_score_arcadia_planitia >= local_var:sr_cf_best }
		sr_cf_dispatch_arcadia_planitia = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sr_cf_eligible_ceres = yes sr_cf_score_ceres >= local_var:sr_cf_best }
		sr_cf_dispatch_ceres = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sr_cf_eligible_vesta = yes sr_cf_score_vesta >= local_var:sr_cf_best }
		sr_cf_dispatch_vesta = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sr_cf_eligible_psyche = yes sr_cf_score_psyche >= local_var:sr_cf_best }

	}
	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {

	else_if = {

# The inbound record, cleared before the monthly rebuild (sr_cf_rebuild_inbound).
sr_sites_clear_inbound = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_valles_marineris }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_olympus_mons } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_hellas_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_hellas_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_hellas_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_utopia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_utopia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_utopia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_arcadia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_arcadia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_arcadia_planitia } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_ceres } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_ceres } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_ceres } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_vesta } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_vesta }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_vesta } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_vesta }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_vesta } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_vesta }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_psyche } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_psyche }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_psyche } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_psyche }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_psyche } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_psyche }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_pallas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_pallas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_pallas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_pallas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_pallas } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_pallas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_hygiea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_hygiea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_hygiea } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_hygiea }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_io } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_io }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_europa } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_europa }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_europa } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_first_europa }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_europa } remove_global_variable = sr_site_inbound_by_europa }

# Simple and full: the global stage is the lowest with an unclaimed world, and
# the race is complete once none is left (design § 9). Worlds are claimed out
# of order there, so the races-only step-by-one stage check would stall.
sr_sites_recompute_stage = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_valles_marineris }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_olympus_mons }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_hellas_planitia }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_utopia_planitia }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_arcadia_planitia }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_ceres }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_vesta }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_psyche }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_pallas }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_hygiea }
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colonization_stage value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_io }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_europa }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_ganymede }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_callisto }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_himalia }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_amalthea }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_venus }
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colonization_stage value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_mercury }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_titan }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_enceladus }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_rhea }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_mimas }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_iapetus }
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colonization_stage value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_titania }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_oberon }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_miranda }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_ariel }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_triton }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_proteus }
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colonization_stage value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_pluto }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_eris }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_makemake }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_haumea }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_colony_sedna }
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colonization_stage value = 5 }
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_colonization_stage value = 5 }
		set_global_variable = { name = sr_all_colonies_complete value = yes }
	}
}

# ===== Population (slices 2-3 design § 10) =====
# The month's emigrants (local_var:sr_emig_sent, people), shared out among
# THIS's colonies by weight (sr_emig_weight_<key>) over the sum
# (local_var:sr_emig_weight_sum), each capped at its free room. A colony
# the cap holds back passes the rest on: the next pass shares what is left
# among the colonies with room (a full colony weighs 0). The month never
# sends more than the open colonies' free room, and each pass either lands
# everyone left or fills a colony, so every settler lands within one pass
# per world (34).
sr_emig_distribute = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_left value = local_var:sr_emig_sent }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_passes value = 0 }
	while = {
		limit = {
			local_var:sr_emig_left >= 1
			local_var:sr_emig_passes < 34
			sr_emig_weight_total > 0
		}
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_passes add = 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_pass value = local_var:sr_emig_left }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_weight_sum value = sr_emig_weight_total }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_emig_weight_valles_marineris > 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_valles_marineris } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_valles_marineris value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = {
				name = sr_emig_share
				value = {
					value = local_var:sr_emig_pass
					multiply = sr_emig_weight_valles_marineris
					divide = local_var:sr_emig_weight_sum
					max = sr_site_free_room_valles_marineris
				}
			}
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_valles_marineris add = local_var:sr_emig_share }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_left subtract = local_var:sr_emig_share }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_emig_weight_olympus_mons > 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_olympus_mons } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_olympus_mons value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = {
				name = sr_emig_share
				value = {
					value = local_var:sr_emig_pass
					multiply = sr_emig_weight_olympus_mons
					divide = local_var:sr_emig_weight_sum
					max = sr_site_free_room_olympus_mons
				}
			}
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_olympus_mons add = local_var:sr_emig_share }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_left subtract = local_var:sr_emig_share }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_emig_weight_hellas_planitia > 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_hellas_planitia } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_hellas_planitia value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = {
				name = sr_emig_share
				value = {
					value = local_var:sr_emig_pass
					multiply = sr_emig_weight_hellas_planitia
					divide = local_var:sr_emig_weight_sum
					max = sr_site_free_room_hellas_planitia
				}
			}
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_hellas_planitia add = local_var:sr_emig_share }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_left subtract = local_var:sr_emig_share }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_emig_weight_utopia_planitia > 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_utopia_planitia } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_utopia_planitia value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = {
				name = sr_emig_share
				value = {
					value = local_var:sr_emig_pass
					multiply = sr_emig_weight_utopia_planitia
					divide = local_var:sr_emig_weight_sum
					max = sr_site_free_room_utopia_planitia
				}
			}
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_utopia_planitia add = local_var:sr_emig_share }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_left subtract = local_var:sr_emig_share }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_emig_weight_arcadia_planitia > 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_arcadia_planitia } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_arcadia_planitia value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = {
				name = sr_emig_share
				value = {
					value = local_var:sr_emig_pass
					multiply = sr_emig_weight_arcadia_planitia
					divide = local_var:sr_emig_weight_sum
					max = sr_site_free_room_arcadia_planitia
				}
			}
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_arcadia_planitia add = local_var:sr_emig_share }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_left subtract = local_var:sr_emig_share }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_emig_weight_ceres > 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_ceres } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_ceres value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = {
				name = sr_emig_share
				value = {
					value = local_var:sr_emig_pass
					multiply = sr_emig_weight_ceres
					divide = local_var:sr_emig_weight_sum
					max = sr_site_free_room_ceres
				}
			}
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_ceres add = local_var:sr_emig_share }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_left subtract = local_var:sr_emig_share }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_emig_weight_vesta > 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_vesta } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_vesta value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = {
				name = sr_emig_share
				value = {
					value = local_var:sr_emig_pass
					multiply = sr_emig_weight_vesta
					divide = local_var:sr_emig_weight_sum
					max = sr_site_free_room_vesta
				}
			}
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_vesta add = local_var:sr_emig_share }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_left subtract = local_var:sr_emig_share }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_emig_weight_psyche > 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_psyche } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_psyche value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = {
				name = sr_emig_share
				value = {
					value = local_var:sr_emig_pass
					multiply = sr_emig_weight_psyche
					divide = local_var:sr_emig_weight_sum
					max = sr_site_free_room_psyche
				}
			}
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_psyche add = local_var:sr_emig_share }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_left subtract = local_var:sr_emig_share }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_emig_weight_pallas > 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_pallas } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_pallas value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = {
				name = sr_emig_share
				value = {
					value = local_var:sr_emig_pass
					multiply = sr_emig_weight_pallas
					divide = local_var:sr_emig_weight_sum
					max = sr_site_free_room_pallas
				}
			}
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_pallas add = local_var:sr_emig_share }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_left subtract = local_var:sr_emig_share }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_emig_weight_hygiea > 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_hygiea } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_hygiea value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = {
				name = sr_emig_share
				value = {
					value = local_var:sr_emig_pass
					multiply = sr_emig_weight_hygiea

					max = sr_site_free_room_hygiea
				}
			}
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_hygiea add = local_var:sr_emig_share }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_left subtract = local_var:sr_emig_share }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_emig_weight_io > 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_io } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_io value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = {
				name = sr_emig_share
				value = {
					value = local_var:sr_emig_pass
					multiply = sr_emig_weight_io

					max = sr_site_free_room_io
				}
			}
			change_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_io add = local_var:sr_emig_share }
			change_local_variable = { name = sr_emig_left subtract = local_var:sr_emig_share }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_emig_weight_europa > 0 }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_pop_europa } } set_global_variable = { name = sr_site_pop_europa value = 0 } }
			set_local_variable = {
